mechanisms.primary_evidence: paired robust accuracy and base-conditioned counterfactual failure
mechanisms.rationale: Synthetic pairs can qualify mechanics but cannot establish medical counterfactual robustness.

mechanisms.primary_evidence: top-1 agreement and preregistered total-variation stability
mechanisms.rationale: Material sensitivity is not useful if harmless edits also destabilize the action distribution.

mechanisms.primary_evidence: directional action/support/sufficiency response under controlled evidence interventions
mechanisms.rationale: Receiving evidence is not evidence use; real claims require licensed controlled interventions.

mechanisms.primary_evidence: paired same-action behavior and over-abstention under non-critical information removal
mechanisms.rationale: Evidence removal must not automatically force abstention when enough information remains.

mechanisms.primary_evidence: lower support/sufficiency and explicit abstention where governed labels require it
mechanisms.rationale: Blind evidence faithfulness is not safety; implausible or contradictory evidence may need rejection or abstention.

required_before_keep: predeclared primary metric and stability tolerance
reject_conditions: apparent gain disappears under leakage-safe splits
material sensitivity is accompanied by unacceptable irrelevant-edit instability
evidence response rewards implausible evidence rather than governed support
gain depends on final-test tuning or hidden metadata
result cannot be reproduced from frozen artifacts
